The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4b9f1ff903605ffa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. statement: The eigenvalue condition σxi = ζxi defines a framed strict formal O-module deformation space of relative height three. Its ungraded base and Lie period are D0 = W(k)[ζ][[r1, r2]], ri = xi/x0 − 1 (i = 1, 2), w = x0. The full ungraded H-fixed base is equivalently W(k)[[s, r1, r2]]/(s2 + 3s + 3), 1 + s = σx0/x0. (3.7) In particular its characteristic-three fibre retains the relation s2 = 0. Set D̄ = D0/(π). There is a C-invariant Hasse section h1 in the line w−2, given by the first strict coefficient of σ. On its zero divisor there is a C-invariant Hasse section h in w−8, given by the second strict coefficient. The ring D′ = D̄/(h1) is a formal disc with parameter hw8; here ideals generated by line sections are read after a period trivialization. Evaluation in cyclic cohomology and reduction modulo π identify K ∼ = D̄ 3 , q ↦−→ w3 . The evaluated V is the D̄3-span of 1, x1/x0, x2/x0 in the line w−2. There is a C-fixed primitive element θ ∈ V , the restriction of the class of t1, which evaluates to h1 up to a nonzero scalar. One may choose a T-basis v, θ, y of V with weights −2, 0, 6, with v = x0/q. Modulo n, gθ = θ, gy = y + c1θ, gv = v + c2y + c3θ, c1c2 ̸= 0. (3.8) Using evaluation to identify cube sections with their unique preimages, put J = h3 1 ∈ Kq−2 , F = q2 J, S0 = K/(F) ∼ = (D′ )3 , W = (V/Kθ) ⊗K S0. Then F is a regular parameter of K, and there is an injective C-equivariant evaluation W −→ w−2 over D′ . After trivializing the line, the evaluations of v, y have orders zero and one, respectively.
